components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;color:var(--paper,#fffaf5);font:12px Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:12px 0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:0;width:100%;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--peach,#f3bbae);outline-offset:7px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-service{color:var(--paper,#fffaf5);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#5c5263);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#5c5263);padding:0 0 7px;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-service summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:25px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,40px);letter-spacing:-.03em}.ds-service summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-service summary:hover{color:var(--peach,#f3bbae)}.ds-service summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--peach,#f3bbae);outline-offset:7px}.ds-plus{position:relative;width:24px;height:24px;flex:none}.ds-plus::before,.ds-plus::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:11px;left:2px;right:2px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transition:transform .3s}.ds-plus::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-service[open] .ds-plus::after{transform:rotate(0)}.ds-service p{max-width:60ch;line-height:1.8;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted,#c9bfcc);padding-bottom:27px;margin:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-plus::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
An immersive, cinematic visual world pairs oversized warm lettering with surreal imagery and quiet interface controls. Depth comes from independently moving background, object, foreground, and text layers. Content surfaces use spacious plum fields and simple ruled rows.

This document captures the implemented local React + Vite concept. MOTION is a provisional working identity; the North Star and descriptive color names summarize the existing direction, not permanent user brand preferences. The user-pinned reference is [wearebrand.io](https://wearebrand.io/), with English content and layered scroll transitions. Page composition and scene-specific imagery remain in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed imagery with independently moving layers.
Heavy Manrope display text and small, restrained navigation.
Warm white and peach against deep plum interface surfaces.
Outline pills, circular arrows, and thin ruled rows.
Stepped scene navigation with an explicit reduced-motion presentation.
dos: **Do** align content and navigation to the shared gutter.
**Do** preserve distinct scene layers when extending scroll transitions.
**Do** keep readable scrims between image detail and foreground text.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, native controls, and the reduced-motion layout.
**Do** identify authored visual projects as concepts until real work is supplied.
donts: **Don't** turn the provisional MOTION identity into an asserted permanent brand commitment.
**Don't** intercept scrolling outside the scene sequence or when reduced motion is enabled.
**Don't** leave visually hidden scene controls keyboard-focusable.
**Don't** imply the local brief download sends a message.
